apps.name: Swipt Nightly
apps.subtitle: iPhone 自动化 · Nightly 测试版
apps.localizedDescription: 通过 JavaScript swiplets 自动操作 iPhone 或 iPad。目前跟踪官方 Nightly 测试构建。版本号和构建号来自官方 altstore.json；同版本号下的新构建也会刷新。源格式兼容不代表此应用的所有功能均可在 LiveContainer 容器内运行；遇到配对、后台或自动化限制时可用 SideStore 独立安装。

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Swipt connects to developer services on this device and, if you publish its API, accepts connections on the local network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Swipt gets your approximate location only to keep automating this device while you use other apps or the device is locked. It doesn’t keep your location or send it anywhere.
